audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart and the prose flatly disagree. content.win and full.phases[].side read Darius/Skill/Akali/Akali/Darius/Akali/Akali, while content.whys[0..5] are all 'You-favoured' and early/mid say 'You dominate 1-2' and 'Levels 3-6 stay firmly yours'. Six of seven whys contradict the row above them.
audit.why: A reader looking at stage 3 sees 'Akali' on the chart and 'You-favoured: E-pull plus W punishes every Q last-hit she attempts' underneath it. One of the two is wrong on every middle row.
audit.corrected: Not corrected here — the underlying win rate is itself contradictory (see notes) and the mirror is unresolved on the same rows. Raised as a question rather than guessed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and first-item spikes describe Akali's power incorrectly: spikes[2] says you 'E-pull through W-shroud', and spikes[3] says her mobility lets her 'dodge your R'.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud makes her unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks — Apprehend cannot be cast on her inside it, so you cannot pull through it. Noxian Guillotine is point-and-click, so it is never dodged; it is only blanked by that same untargetability. Both spikes teach the wrong reaction.
audit.corrected: Her spikes are Twilight Shroud (20/19/18/17/16), first AP item, and Perfect Execution (120/90/60); yours are Crippling Strike plus Apprehend online, level 6, and Stridebreaker.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction of the lane is never stated: Twilight Shroud blocks targeted casts, so Apprehend and Noxian Guillotine both fail inside it, but Decimate is an untargeted arc and still damages her through the smoke. The content layer also names none of her abilities (packet defect).
audit.why: Riot's Twilight Shroud text says she is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' and that using abilities briefly reveals her. Riot's Decimate text is a wide circular swing with no target. That asymmetry is the whole answer to shroud and it was replaced with 'body-block the smoke', which does nothing.
audit.corrected: Swing Decimate through the shroud; hold Apprehend and Guillotine for the moment she casts and reveals herself. Note the range gap too: Five Point Strike is 550, Apprehend is 535.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Twilight Shroud' appears in focus, loading, cooldowns and three phase reasons without ever saying how long it is down.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16 and Shuriken Flip is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10. Perfect Execution is 120/90/60. Those numbers are what convert 'wait' into a decision.
audit.corrected: Shroud's 20s rank-1 cooldown written into dosFull[0].d and breakdown.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave has the 'Key Mechanical Cooldowns' and 'How Darius Wins Trades' template blocks pasted into the middle of it, so the Wave Management section is mostly trading and cooldown copy that already appears verbatim in breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.trading.
audit.why: The reader gets the same paragraph three times and no actual wave advice for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Replaced with real wave content keyed to Akali: she has no wave-clear before her first AP item, so a freeze starves her roams and her shove costs energy.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every dosFull and dontsFull description is boilerplate that does not match its own title, and breakdown.mid and dosFull[1].d call Akali 'he'.
audit.why: 'Bait her energy' is explained with 'Pull Akali as he steps to last-hit, W slow, land the Q outer ring' — a generic trade line, wrong pronoun, and no mention of energy.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title with Akali's real cooldowns and correct pronouns.

edits.before: Sweep her active smoke ring with your wide-arc Decimate blade edge, hook her mid-air during shuriken flip retreats, and avoid ultimate execution lines.
edits.after: Sweep her Twilight Shroud with Decimate's wide arc — the untargeted blade lands where Apprehend cannot click — and commit only once Perfect Execution is spent.

edits.before: Akali pokes with Q and goes untargetable in her W, bursting at 6. Survive her 6, pull her when her W/energy are down, and bleed her out before she shroud-resets. Don't chase past the wave into Twilight Shroud.
edits.after: Five Point Strike pokes from 550 and Twilight Shroud, 20s at rank 1, drops her targetability. Pull the moment Shroud is spent and bleed her out. Decimate still lands inside the smoke; Apprehend cannot be cast into it.

edits.before: Freeze near your tower and make Akali walk into Apprehend range. Every trade should bank 3-5 bleed stacks; at 5, Noxian Might + R is a kill. If behind, farm with Q and wait for his Twilight Shroud mistake.
edits.after: Freeze near your tower and make Akali walk into Apprehend range. Every trade should bank 3-5 bleed stacks; at 5, Noxian Might + R is a kill. If behind, farm with Q and wait out her Shroud, 20s at rank 1.

edits.before: Best wave: your highest priority is maintaining a slow-building freeze locked directly outside your turret range. This completely denies them the safety of a short lane, leaves them highly exposed to devastating jungle collapses, and grants you an incredibly long runway to activate Ghost and run them down the lane the exact millisecond they waste an essential safety mechanism. Key Mechanical Cooldowns Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane. How Darius Wins Trades Look for them to walk forward to secure a critical minion last hit. Step up instantly, land an auto-attack directly into a fast Crippling Strike (W) reset, and use the heavy slow to step back out of their counter-abilities. If they panic and waste their primary mobility or crowd control tool, activate Ghost immediately, pull them back with Apprehend, and stack your passive to full for an easy execution loop. Worst wave: shoved to his tower with Apprehend and Ghost down. Crash timing: only crash to reset, take plates, or set up a dive — never shove on autopilot.
edits.after: Best wave: a slow-building freeze locked just outside your turret range. That denies Akali the safety of a short lane, leaves her exposed to jungle collapses, and gives you a long runway to Ghost her down the second Twilight Shroud is spent. The freeze also starves her, because Akali has no real wave-clear tool before her first AP item — a wave she cannot shove is a wave she cannot leave to roam from, and every Five Point Strike she buries in minions is energy she will not have for the trade you start next. Worst wave: shoved to her tower with Apprehend and Ghost down. That is her dive-safe ground and a long walk home for you, and it hands her the roam timer for free. Crash timing: only crash to reset, take plates, or set up a dive — never on autopilot. Time the crash so the bounce arrives while Shroud is still on its 20-second cooldown, and hard shove before you recall so the wave dies under her tower instead of settling into a freeze on her side. A freeze in Akali's favour is thirty seconds of free 550-range poke you cannot answer, plus the roam window that is her actual win condition. Wave first, duel second: she only gets to spend her map value if you let the wave sit where she wants it.

edits.before: Untargetable inside it. Pull when down. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1. Once spent she has no reset — that is your commit window.

edits.before: Pull Akali as he steps to last-hit, W slow, land the Q outer ring, weave two autos, and walk away at 3-4 stacks with the heal banked.
edits.after: Five Point Strike is a 1.5s cooldown but energy-hungry. Let her spend it on the wave, then step up while she is dry and Apprehend.

edits.before: Akali wastes Twilight Shroud — commit the full combo immediately.
edits.after: Guillotine is true damage — fire it the instant she leaves smoke.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refusing it removes half his win condition.

edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.before: Whiffing Apprehend and then fighting anyway — without the pull you have no engage, and chasing through a wave bleeds you dry.
edits.after: Five Point Strike reaches 550 and Apprehend only 535 — she chips you from fifteen units outside your pull. Start Doran's Shield.

edits.before: Akali's Q poke chunks you, but she's melee-range fragile: when she steps up to last-hit, E-pull her and land the Q inner-ring plus W. Five Hemorrhage stacks blow through her tiny early health pool.
edits.after: Five Point Strike chunks you from 550, but Apprehend reaches 535 and she is paper: when she steps to last-hit, pull her into an inner Decimate plus W. Five Hemorrhage stacks end her early health bar.

edits.before: Her R gives two dashes and an execute, but you still hold the edge: if she shrouds (W), you can body-block the smoke or just walk out. Your R execute out-damages her burst if you keep Hemorrhage stacked.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is two dashes and an execute, but you hold the edge: Twilight Shroud blocks targeting, not Decimate — swing the blade through the smoke, and the moment she casts she is revealed and pullable.

edits.before: With her first AP item Akali's Q + E + R burst climbs, but your Trinity/Stridebreaker + Hemorrhage still lets you E-pull through W-shroud and delete her the moment she commits.
edits.after: With her first AP item the Five Point Strike into Shuriken Flip burst climbs, but Stridebreaker plus Hemorrhage still deletes her the moment she flips in and gives up her untargetability.

edits.before: Akali out-scales into assassin roam and pick potential; her shroud, dashes and burst let her dodge your R in the open. Your 1v1 stays strong but her map value overtakes you in items.
edits.after: Akali out-scales into roam and pick potential; Twilight Shroud blanks your point-and-click Guillotine outright and Shuriken Flip leaves your range. Your 1v1 holds but her map value passes you.

edits.before: You dominate 1-2: Akali is a squishy melee with a short early Q, so your Q outer-ring and Hemorrhage bleed win any point-blank exchange. Deny her the free Q poke by threatening the E-pull whenever she steps to a minion.
edits.after: You dominate 1-2: Akali is squishy and has only Five Point Strike, so Decimate's outer ring and Hemorrhage bleed win any point-blank exchange. Threaten Apprehend, 26s at rank 1, whenever she steps toward a minion.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay firmly yours — W and E let you pull her out of position, and 5-stack Hemorrhage plus your R execute punch straight through her thin health bar before her energy sustain matters. Don't chase her Q pokes into your own tower.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay firmly yours — Crippling Strike and Apprehend drag her out of position, and 5-stack Hemorrhage plus Guillotine's true damage punch straight through her thin health bar. Don't chase Five Point Strike poke past your own wave.

edits.after: Only at her first AP item does she pull ahead: Twilight Shroud blanks point-and-click Guillotine and Perfect Execution's two dashes leave your range. Keep the lane short, deny roams, and win before she itemizes.
